notes: Manual extraction from GpxLoopSimilarityTest output. The -Dloop.baseline.capture flag specified in the spec is not yet implemented; numbers below are computed from per-scenario runtimeMillis and score fields in the harness JSON, with averageRouteReuse parsed from the Markdown summary table (the JSON writer does not currently emit reuse).
Sample sizes (n=6 for smallCorpus, n=1 for known100kmBasel) are small. Median/p95 over 6 samples is statistically noisy; interpret as order-of-magnitude indicators rather than precise budgets.
rejectionReasonDistribution categories follow the per-scenario error string: keys are best-effort substrings rather than a closed enum. Phase 1 may formalize this.

MAX_SELF_INTERSECTIONS is 5 at this commit (RoundTripQualityGate.java:93). The known 100 km Basel long-loop fails with 21 self-intersections — this is the headline failure mode the closure-aware reranking work targets.
